flows.reorg.reorg_equity_payment_share.formula: the consideration is credited as MiRXEA's paid-in registered capital of Huzhou Mirui, i.e. Huzhou Mirui pays with its own equity (财税〔2009〕59号 Article 2); no cash mentioned — equity payment share 100%

event.on.basis: re-dated: the real reorganisation date is 2023-06-14, the library holds only current law (decision D30), moved as a whole to 2026-06-14

event.dividend.quote: the Group’s unutilized tax losses incurred by its subsidiaries in the PRC of US$19,594,884, US$30,734,686 and US$37,305,694 respectively will expire within five years from the year in which the tax losses originated.
event.dividend.basis: the Mainland subsidiaries have unrecovered losses and have distributed no dividend to date, undistributed profits not disclosed; one dividend of RMB10,000,000 is taken, for testing only

event.onward.basis: the intermediate company passes all the dividends it receives on to the Singapore parent

notes: Source: Mirxes Holding Company Limited (2629.HK, incorporated in the Cayman Islands) prospectus of 2025-05-15 (cases/sources/K3-mirxes-2025/source.pdf). K3 semi-synthetic: structure, ratios, dates and the reorganisation consideration come from the prospectus; the dividend amount, date and years are synthetic values (see provenance).

Only the part within the three jurisdictions is taken: ULT is MiRXEA Pte. Ltd. (Singapore investment holding), HOLD is Huzhou Mirui (Mainland wholly foreign-owned enterprise, established 2023-05-05), OP is Hangzhou Miwei; MiRXES Holding Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) above them and the Cayman listed company are not in this case.

The current state is taken before the reorganisation: MiRXEA holds Hangzhou Miwei directly. The actual choice is HOLD=CN: on 2023-06-14 MiRXEA transferred 100% of Hangzhou Miwei to Huzhou Mirui for RMB83,463,359.41, credited as its paid-in registered capital of US$11,662,432 in Huzhou Mirui (pdf 288), the situation of 财税〔2009〕59号 Article 7(2) (decision D35); the prospectus mentions no special tax treatment, filing or tax paid. The reorganisation date is moved to 2026-06-14.
Not disclosed: MiRXEA's paid-in amount and tax basis in Hangzhou Miwei, the pricing basis of the consideration, the registration completion date — asked by the program. Amounts are in RMB.

names: each party's defined term / full name in the document (aliases separated by /), individuals written as in the document, used for locating extraction patterns, search queries and registry look-ups (抽取改造.md §2, §7)
